title: Best Graphy Alternative in India (2026): 5 Options Compared
description: Five Graphy alternatives for Indian educators, with prices and fees from each official site, own app and domain compared, and when staying on Graphy is the right call.
og_description: Exly, TagMango, Learnyst, Kajabi and AllCoaching compared as Graphy alternatives, with every price taken from the official site and dated, and an honest note on when to stay on Graphy.

h1: Best Graphy Alternative for Course Creators and Educators in India (2026): 5 Options Compared
dek: A fair comparison of the platforms Indian educators most often weigh against Graphy, with every competitor price taken from its official site and dated, and a plain answer on which one suits which kind of teaching business.
cover_alt: Looking for a Graphy alternative: Exly, TagMango, Learnyst, Kajabi and AllCoaching compared, with prices checked on official sites on 24 Oct 2026
audience: Indian educators, tutors and course sellers comparing Graphy alternatives
intro: The best Graphy alternative depends on what you sell and what you want to own: for an educator who wants a website on their own domain and their own Android and iOS app, set up without a sales call, AllCoaching is the closest fit; for selling sessions and digital products to followers, Exly; for mock tests, Learnyst; and for a dollar-paying global audience, Kajabi. If Graphy already works for you and your sales are steady, staying is a reasonable choice.

We are AllCoaching, so read this knowing who wrote it. Every competitor price below comes from that company's own pricing page, with the link and the date we checked it, and we say where another platform fits better than ours.

One thing we could not do is quote Graphy's rupee prices. Graphy publishes plans on graphy.com/pricing, but prices are shown by country and we could not confirm the Indian rupee plans on 24 Oct 2026; check the page from India.[1] So this guide compares Graphy on what it offers, and compares the alternatives on what they publish.
takeaways: Graphy's rupee prices could not be confirmed on 24 Oct 2026: its pricing page shows prices by country, and from our connection it showed US dollar plans. Check graphy.com/pricing from India before comparing.
Graphy offers a 14-day free trial and describes itself as an all-in-one platform with a website builder, branded apps, digital products and AI sales agents.
AllCoaching starts at ₹6,999 a year plus 10% on sales (Starter), with Growth ₹12,999 + 7.5% and Pro ₹24,999 + 5%; GST extra; 14-day free trial with no card.
Exly's Starter plan has no upfront fee and takes a 10% commission; its own mobile app (iOS and Android) is an add-on from ₹60,000 a year.

On published prices, Exly Starter costs less than AllCoaching up to about ₹5 lakh of sales a year if you do not need your own app; with Exly's app add-on, AllCoaching costs less at every level we checked.
Learnyst publishes ₹10,000 a year + 10% (Launcher) and 0%-fee plans from ₹8,099 a month billed annually; TagMango and Kajabi also publish prices, Kajabi in US dollars.
You can switch without losing students by running both platforms side by side until your current batches finish.

sections.h2: The short answer: pick by what you need
sections.html:
There is no single best Graphy alternative for everyone. There is a best fit for each kind of teaching business, so start from the problem you want to solve.

{{fig:verdict|Which Graphy alternative to choose by need: own website and app built yourself, AllCoaching; sessions and digital products to followers, Exly; mostly mock tests, Learnyst; dollar-paying global audience, Kajabi; steady sales on Graphy, stay|Pick the row that sounds like you. The rest of this guide explains each choice.}}

If you are still unsure, the next two sections explain how we compared and why educators usually start looking.

sections.h2: How we compared Graphy and its alternatives
sections.html:
We compared Graphy with five platforms Indian educators often shortlist against it: AllCoaching, Exly, TagMango, Learnyst and Kajabi. We looked at the five things a teaching business pays for or depends on.

  1. Price you can see before signing up, taken only from each company's own pricing page.
  2. Fee on your sales, because a percentage changes the total as you grow.
  3. What you own: your domain, your Android and iOS app listing, and your student data.
  4. How you start: a self-serve trial, or a demo and sales call.
  5. Who it is built for: exam academies, skill teachers, coaches selling sessions, or a global audience.
Disclosure: AllCoaching publishes this guide. Competitor figures link to their official pages and carry the date we checked them (24 Oct 2026). Prices change; check the source before you decide. If you spot an error, write to contact@allcoaching.in and we will correct it.

sections.h2: Why educators look for a Graphy alternative
sections.html:
Graphy is a capable, well-known platform, and for many educators selling to an existing YouTube or Instagram audience it does the job well. The reasons people start comparing usually fall into three groups.

1. Not being sure what you will pay in rupees

When we opened Graphy's pricing page on 24 Oct 2026, it showed US dollar plans from our connection, and the rupee figures inside the page did not agree with each other. That does not mean anything is wrong with Graphy's pricing. It means you should see the rupee plan, the fee per sale and GST in writing before you compare.

{{q:Is Graphy too expensive, or am I just not selling enough yet?|Usually it is about stage, not the platform. A yearly plan feels heavy when sales are small and light when they grow. Ask Graphy for the rupee price and fee per sale for your plan, then compare the total at your real sales level, not the headline number.}}

2. Wanting your own app on every plan

Many educators now expect their own Android and iOS app, under their own name, from day one. Check which Graphy plan includes the iOS app; on several platforms the app is a higher tier or a paid add-on.

3. Wanting students to find you, not only buy from you

A course platform gives you a place to sell. Bringing buyers is still your job: your YouTube channel, Instagram, WhatsApp groups and Google search. Graphy's pricing page does not describe a built-in student marketplace, so ask whether one exists. We cover this angle in detail in our guide to a Graphy alternative with organic traffic.

{{fig:before-after|Before and after: comparing plans with open questions about rupee price, fee per sale, iOS app and domain, compared with one academy with its price published, your own domain and your own Android and iOS app|Whatever you choose, get the full price in writing first.}}

sections.h2: What the alternatives really cost as you grow
sections.html:
A yearly price tells only half the story when a platform also takes a percentage. The chart adds each published plan price to its published fee at five sales levels and picks the lowest-cost plan each time. Graphy is not in the chart because we could not confirm its rupee prices.

{{fig:cost|Total yearly cost at sales levels up to ₹10 lakh from published prices for AllCoaching, Exly, Learnyst and TagMango with a custom domain|Before GST. TagMango includes the ₹24,999 Freedom Setup needed for a custom domain. Exly's line does not include its mobile app add-on.}} {{cost_table}}

The honest reading: if you do not need your own app or domain, Exly's Starter plan costs less than AllCoaching up to about ₹5 lakh of sales a year, because it has no upfront fee. Add Exly's mobile app add-on (from ₹60,000 a year) and AllCoaching costs less at every level in the chart. Learnyst's Launcher plan sits close to AllCoaching Starter at low sales, and above about ₹14.4 lakh a year its 0%-fee Professional plan (₹97,188 a year billed annually) costs less than AllCoaching Pro. Use our plan finder to run your own numbers, and our guide on how to price online courses in India to set the course price itself.

{{cta}}

New educator selling the first course

Keep fixed costs low and start quickly. A self-serve platform with a 14-day trial lets you build and test before you commit. Our guide on how to sell courses online in India walks through the first sale.

YouTube teacher moving viewers to paid courses

You need a website on your own domain and an app your viewers can install from a link in the description. See how to monetise a YouTube teaching channel with your own app and LMS with a custom domain.

Coach selling sessions, cohorts and digital products

Exly and TagMango are built around this. If you also want structured courses, live batches and your own app on the same plan, compare them with an academy platform. Our Exly alternative for coaches guide goes deeper.

Test-series academy (SSC, banking, NEET, JEE)

If most of your income comes from mocks, look closely at Learnyst's test engine and compare it with building tests inside your own academy. See best platform for selling PDF notes and test series.

Selling mainly abroad

If your students pay in dollars, a USD platform such as Kajabi may suit you better than an India-first one. Our Kajabi alternative in India guide covers the other direction.

sections.h2: How to switch from Graphy without losing students
sections.html:
The safe way to switch is to run both platforms side by side. Current students keep access on Graphy until their batch or validity ends; new students join your new academy.

{{fig:switch|Four steps to switch from Graphy: build your academy, run both side by side, move new admissions, close the old plan when the Graphy term ends|Nobody loses access, and nobody pays twice.}} {{steps}}

The full checklist, including messages to send students, is in how to switch coaching apps without losing students.

items: Start the 14-day trial, connect your domain and upload one complete course with a free demo lesson.
Run both platforms side by side
Keep current students on Graphy until their batch or course validity ends, so nobody loses access.
Send new students to your academy
Put your own website and app link in your YouTube descriptions, Instagram bio and WhatsApp groups.
Export records and close the old plan
Download student and payment records from Graphy, then let the plan end at its renewal date.

faq: What is the best Graphy alternative in India in 2026?

It depends on what you sell. AllCoaching fits educators who want their own website and Android and iOS app built themselves, from ₹6,999 a year plus a fee on sales. Exly suits coaches selling sessions and digital products, Learnyst suits test-heavy academies, Kajabi suits a global audience, and staying on Graphy is reasonable if your sales are steady.
How much does Graphy cost in India?

We could not confirm it. Graphy publishes plans on graphy.com/pricing, but prices are shown by country and we could not confirm the Indian rupee plans on 24 Oct 2026. Check the page from India and ask for the fee per sale and GST in writing.
Does Graphy have a free trial?
Yes. Graphy's pricing page offers a 14-day free trial. AllCoaching also starts with a 14-day free trial, and no card is needed to start it.
Is there a Graphy alternative with no upfront fee?

Yes. Exly's Starter plan has no upfront fee and takes a 10% commission, and TagMango's Basic plan has no fixed fee and takes 10% for up to 200 students. AllCoaching is not one of these: it has one annual plan from ₹6,999 a year plus 10% on sales, with your own domain and Android and iOS app included.
How is AllCoaching different from Graphy?

AllCoaching includes a website on your own domain and your own white-label Android and iOS app on every plan, with unlimited live classes and UPI checkout, set up yourself in the studio. Its prices are published in rupees, and courses can also be discovered on the AllCoaching marketplace app.
Can I move my courses and students from Graphy without losing them?
Yes. Build your new academy, keep current students on Graphy until their batch ends, send new students to your own website and app, then export your records and let the Graphy plan end at renewal.
Which Graphy alternative is best for a small or new educator?

A new educator usually does best with a low fixed cost and a trial, so they can build and sell before paying much. Exly Starter has no upfront fee if you do not need your own app; AllCoaching starts at ₹6,999 a year with your own app and domain included and a 14-day free trial.
Do Graphy alternatives bring you students?

Mostly no; finding students stays your job on most platforms. AllCoaching also lists your courses on its marketplace app, which helps discovery, but your own website, YouTube, Instagram and WhatsApp remain the main ways students find you.
